20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.prompt: Marka xylophone la garaaco, isbarbardhigga heerka codka ee furaha gaaban iyo furaha dheer waa kuwee sax ah?

20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Furaha gaaban inta uu sii gaabanyahay ayuu si dhaqso badan u gariiraa oo codka sare soo saaraa
